title: Optimize a prompt against a held-out eval set
question: How do I let an agent rewrite a prompt without it learning the answer key?
teaches: a harness bug and a bad prompt produce the same low number
spread: none can be a symptom of a broken harness, not a stable metric
the eval harness should self-test before it scores anything
mean field accuracy over whole-case accuracy, to avoid ties
an exact tie reverts, seen on real data

recorded.agent: claude CLI headless (proposer); claude-haiku-4-5 (system under test)

observed.note: trials 2 and 3 are inside the noise; run used no --min-delta, which was a mistake that only trial 1's margin excused
